mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE l.operate_type WHEN 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN 3 THEN 0 ELSE o.total_amount END ), 0) FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT l.id AS log_id, l.operate_type AS event_type, l.create_time AS event_time, l.order_id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, o.goods_name, o.goods_sn, o.goods_thumb, o.session_id, o.session_name, o.buyer_id, o.buyer_name, o.buyer_phone, CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 3 THEN 0 ELSE o.quantity END AS flow_quantity, o.unit_price, CASE l.operate_type WHEN 2 THEN -o.total_amount WHEN 3 THEN 0 ELSE o.total_amount END AS signed_total_amount, l.operate_user_id AS operator_id, l.operate_user_name AS operator_name, l.remark FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.profit_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_profit_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.recommend_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_recommend_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.self_buy_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.self_buy_bonus_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_bonus_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 1 THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_self_buy_coupon_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.operate_type = 2 THEN o.self_buy_coupon_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversal_self_buy_coupon_amount FROM t_rob_order_operate_log l INNER JOIN t_rob_order o ON o.id = l.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
